instruction:
Fix `plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. minor (line 546): The useAsyncRetry deps include renamedFromEntityRef. After a rename redirect, the first in-page navigation (for example clicking a tab) drops the router state, so the marker goes from a string to undefined. That re-runs getEntityByRef for the entity that is already loaded and sets loading=true, and EntityLayout shows <Progress /> while it runs. The result is a redundant catalog request and a progress-bar flash. The marker is only needed as a loop guard at the moment kind/namespace/name change, and it changes in the same render as they do. — fix: Read the marker through a ref that is updated on every render (const renamedFromRef = useRef(renamedFromEntityRef); renamedFromRef.current = renamedFromEntityRef) and use renamedFromRef.current inside the async callback. Keep the deps at [catalogApi, kind, namespace, name] as before. The loop guard behaves the same because the redirect sets the new params and the state at once.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "plugins/catalog/src/components/CatalogEntityPage/useEntityFromUrl.ts", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
